program.name: Mat Foundations
program.subject: Pilates
program.blurb: The Pilates mat basics, learned properly: the hundred, the abs series, spine work and side-lying legs.
program.about: The Pilates mat basics, learned slowly and properly. Each session starts with the hundred, then moves through the abs series, the spine and back, and side-lying leg work. Two versions alternate so you meet every foundation move within a few days. Levels II and III add a few reps each time. One Start runs each series and the voice names every exercise.
